scripts.resources: python3 tools/svg2pdc.py --normalize --out resources/casita casita-svgs/Normal.svg casita-svgs/Happy.svg casita-svgs/Grinning.svg && python3 tools/svg2pdc.py --normalize --body-color '#f7931e' --out resources/casita 'casita-svgs/No internet.svg' && python3 tools/svg2pdc.py --normalize --body-color '#999999' --out resources/casita casita-svgs/Sleeping.svg && python3 tools/svg2pdc.py --out resources/icons mdi-svgs/thermometer.svg mdi-svgs/shoe-print.svg mdi-svgs/calendar-blank.svg && python3 tools/svg2pdc.py --normalize --body-color '#f44336' --name batterylow.pdc --out resources/icons mdi-svgs/battery.svg && python3 tools/svg2pdc.py --normalize --body-color '#ff9800' --name batterymedium.pdc --out resources/icons mdi-svgs/battery.svg && python3 tools/svg2pdc.py --normalize --body-color '#4caf50' --name batteryhigh.pdc --out resources/icons mdi-svgs/battery.svg
scripts.typecheck: bun run render-config && tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.pkjs.json
scripts.build:pkjs: bun run render-config && bun build src/pkjs/index.ts --outfile src/pkjs/index.js --target browser --format iife
scripts.build: bun run resources && bun run build:pkjs && pebble build
